steps.player: You don't look very well. Are you alright?
Dead as in... feeling a bit under the weather?

steps.npc: No, dead as in I got stabbed and died.

steps.player: That's awful! How are you still here? And how can you still talk?

steps.npc: Eve brought me back from the afterlife. She's a party lion, that one.

steps.player: How could she bring you back from the afterlife?

steps.npc: I'm not sure how the magic works exactly. Only Eve knows that. All I know is that she usually does this every year.

steps.player: I didn't see her around last year. Are you sure she always comes here?

steps.npc: She returns to the world of the living every year. That doesn't mean she has to go to Lumbridge Swamp every year.

options.text: What more can you tell me about the afterlife?

steps.player: What more can you tell me about the afterlife?

steps.npc: Not a lot. Most of it you'd have to see for yourself.

steps.player: I don't feel quite ready for that yet.

steps.npc: And I was going to offer you a quick way there... what a shame.

options.text: Why do you choose to come back?

steps.player: Why do you choose to come back?

steps.npc: While the afterlife is not that bad, I do sometimes miss some things from when I used to be alive. There's nothing quite like Eve's special brew.

steps.player: So you just come here for fun? Like on holiday?

steps.npc: You could say that. I could always come back to haunt people, but that gets tedious after a while. I'd much rather enjoy my time here.

steps.player: Well I'm glad you're not causing any harm by being here.

steps.npc: The only way I'd cause harm is if someone were to interrupt my enjoying this party.
